execute:

---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)

```

```{r}
lm_dir <- here("data", "raw", "lantmateriet")

gpkg_files <- list.files(
  lm_dir,
  pattern = "\\.gpkg$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

gpkg_files

```

## Layers

```{r}
map(
  gpkg_files,
  \(file) {
    cat("\n\n###", basename(file), "\n")
    print(st_layers(file))
  }
)

```

## Mark

```{r}
mark_file <- gpkg_files[str_detect(gpkg_files, "mark")]

st_layers(mark_file)
```

## Administrativ boundaries

```{r}
admin_file <- gpkg_files[str_detect(gpkg_files, "administrativindelning")]

st_layers(admin_file)

```

## Hydrology

```{r}
hydro_file <- gpkg_files[str_detect(gpkg_files, "hydrografi")]

st_layers(hydro_file)
```
